changelog: Fixes AnimeThemes synonym and year matching, adds safe ED1 fallback and original-title lookup, refreshes the negative cache, and writes an actionable missing-theme report.
description: Finds missing TV series themes through ThemerrDB, strictly matched AnimeThemes openings or safe endings, and Plex, then saves normalized theme.mp3 files without overwriting existing themes.
name: Theme Music Finder
overview: Finds missing TV series theme music and saves it as theme.mp3.
